Adds the new rows before (false) or afte: Adds the new rows before (false) or after (true) the specified cell. If no cell is specified, then this parameter will be ignored.

The possible value for this parameter is: The possible value for this parameter is a language identifier as defined by RFC 4646/BCP 47. Example: "en-CA".

The distance from the bottom edge of the: The distance from the bottom edge of the page to the bottom edge of the footer measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

The value for the amount of space to the: The value for the amount of space to the left extent of the cell measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch). The available types of the text directio: The available types of the text direction in the table cell: "lrtb" - text direction left-to-right moving from top to bottom, "tbrl" - text direction top-to-bottom moving from right to left, "btlr" - text direction bottom-to-top moving from left to right.
The URL of the image to be used for the: The URL of the image to be used for the content control. Currently, only internet URLs are supported.
The date language. Possible value for th: The date language. Possible value for this parameter is a language identifier as defined by RFC 4646/BCP 47. Example: "en-CA".

When set to **true**, the cells within t: When set to **true**, the cells within the selected range will be merged along the rows, but remain split in the columns. When set to **false**, the whole selected range of cells will be merged into a single cell.

The series name. Can be a range of cells: The series name. Can be a range of cells or usual text. For example: "'sheet 1'!$A$2:$A$5" - must be a single cell, row or column, "A1:A5" - must be a single cell, row or column, "Example series".
A range of cells from the sheet with the: A range of cells from the sheet with the category names. For example: "'sheet 1'!$A$2:$A$5" - must be a single cell, row or column, "A1:A5" - must be a single cell, row or column.

Up to 255 items, or ranges to count numb: Up to 255 items, or ranges to count numbers. The first argument is required, subsequent arguments are optional. Arguments can be numbers, logical values and text representations of numbers, ranges, names, or arrays.

An optional numeric value that specifies: An optional numeric value that specifies the length of the seasonal pattern. The default value of 1 indicates seasonality is detected automatically. The 0 value means no seasonality.

According to the European method, the start and end dates that occur on the 31st of a month become equal to the 30th of the same month. According to the U.S. method, the start date is the last day of a month, it becomes equal to the 30th of the same month. If the end date is the last day of a month and the start date is earlier than the 30th of a month, the end date becomes equal to the 1st of the next month. Otherwise the end date becomes equal to the 30th of the same month.
A number that determines the type of ret: A number that determines the type of return value: **1** - returns a number from 1 (Sunday) to 7 (Saturday); **2** - returns a number from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday); **3** - returns a number from 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday).

Up to 253 numeric values or a range of c: Up to 253 numeric values or a range of cells containing the values for which the aggregate value will be returned. Arguments can be numbers, ranges, or arrays of numbers.
